text: 卖淫合法了，会使强奸犯变少。
en: If prostitution were legalised, there would be fewer rapists.

text: 强奸犯的关键在于他的目的就是要强奸A，这和嫖娼是否犯法毫无关系。
en: The crux of a rapist is that his very purpose is to rape A; this has absolutely nothing to do with whether soliciting is against the law.

text: 会说出这种话的人，一般属于脑子发育不健全，或者脑子被精虫吃了，不建议与之继续交谈。
en: People who would say such things generally have underdeveloped brains, or their brains have been eaten by lust; I would not recommend continuing to talk to them.

text: 大多数人都搞不懂卖淫究竟是一件什么性质的事。
en: Most people cannot grasp what sort of matter prostitution actually is.

text: 第一个问题。
en: The first question.

text: 中国卖淫非法，为什么还有那么多卖淫的？
en: Prostitution is illegal in China, so why are there still so many prostitutes?

text: 这个回答下面列举的各种坏处根本不是卖淫合法化这件事的坏处，而是卖淫这件事本身的坏处。
en: The various downsides listed beneath this answer are not downsides of legalising prostitution at all, but rather downsides inherent to prostitution itself.

text: 要解决你们说的问题，要处理的不是卖淫合不合法的问题 而是怎么禁止卖淫的问题。
en: To solve the problems you mention, what needs to be dealt with is not whether prostitution is legal or not, but rather how to prohibit prostitution.

text: 但问题就在这，卖淫根本禁止不了。
en: But that is precisely the problem: prostitution simply cannot be prohibited.

text: 朝鲜都有鸡。
en: Even North Korea has prostitutes.

text: 这就很能说明问题了。
en: That speaks volumes in itself.

text: 你说有一个按钮，按一下就没人卖淫嫖娼了，按不按，那我肯定按。
en: Suppose there were a button that, if pressed, meant no one ever sold or bought sex again — would I press it? Of course I would.

text: 但没有这个按钮，不是你说卖淫非法，鸡就不卖了，你说卖淫合法，你老婆孩子就去卖了。
en: But there is no such button. Just because you declare prostitution illegal does not mean the prostitutes stop selling, and just because you declare it legal does not mean your wife and children go and sell themselves.

text: 中国卖淫非法，但那又怎么样，还不是有鸡。
en: Prostitution is illegal in China, but so what? There are still prostitutes.

text: 只要你会上外网，X和电报多少鸡别说你不知道。
en: As long as you can get on the foreign internet, you cannot claim ignorance of how many prostitutes there are on X and Telegram.

text: 但凡三线以上的城市都有线上鸡群。
en: Any city above third-tier has online circles of prostitutes.

text: 小角落的洗脚店里在干什么别说你不知道。
en: Do not pretend you do not know what goes on in the back-corner foot-massage parlours.

text: 还有沙井吧，里面的人在聊什么别说你不知道。
en: And Shajing, for instance — do not say you do not know what the people there are talking about.

text: 各种嘲讽土木的视频里一定有洗脚梗，这是什么意思？
en: Every video mocking civil engineering is bound to contain a foot-massage-parlour in-joke — what does that mean?

text: KTV摸摸唱又是什么意思？
en: And what does 'touch-and-sing' in a KTV mean?

text: 你知，我知，老爷们也知道。
en: You know it, I know it, and the authorities know it too.

text: 为什么不把这些鸡窝端了？
en: Why not raid these brothels, then?

text: 首先，卖淫不触犯刑法，嫖娼也不触犯刑法，只有组织卖淫触犯刑法。
en: First, prostitution does not violate the criminal law, nor does soliciting; only organising prostitution violates the criminal law.

text: 前面两个只会受治安处罚。
en: The first two are only subject to public security penalties.

text: 如果你是中产良家子，良家女，是工作体面的白领，那治安处罚对你来说就是天塌了，人生毁了。
en: If you are a middle-class person of decent family, a respectable woman, a white-collar worker with a proper job, then a public security punishment feels like the sky falling in — your life is ruined.

text: 但对于底层百姓，那种三和大神，治安处罚根本就不放在眼里的。
en: But for people at the bottom, the sort of 'Sanhe gods', a public security punishment is simply beneath their notice.

text: 公权力也不可能为了治安处罚付太大的代价。
en: Nor can public power afford to pay too high a price merely for public security punishments.

text: 而且事实上，除了有特点地点的卖淫，你点对点开个房的个体户卖淫小心点几乎不会被抓。
en: And in fact, apart from prostitution at fixed locations, point-to-point prostitution where you book a room as a self-employed operator will almost never be caught if you are careful.

text: 这个东西非法，但就是存在，而且规模庞大。
en: This thing is illegal, yet it exists all the same, and on a massive scale.

text: 好，那我们下定决心，彻底扫除卖淫。
en: Very well, then let us resolve to wipe out prostitution completely.

text: 如果你这么想，那第一个问题——
en: If that is what you think, then the first question —

text: 卖淫嫖娼入不入刑
en: Whether prostitution and soliciting should be criminalised.

text: 先回答这个问题，不入刑，只是治安处罚就没法对个体户卖淫产业进行有效的打击。
en: Answer this question first: if it is not criminalised and only subject to public security punishment, there is no way to strike effectively at the self-employed prostitution industry.

text: 因为规格不够，罪责刑相适应，举重以明轻，举轻以明重。
en: Because the level is not high enough — punishment must fit the crime; by weighing the serious one can clarify the light, by weighing the light one can clarify the serious.

text: 不入刑就不可能受到太严厉的惩罚，不然那么多更严重的违法犯罪怎么办？
en: If it is not criminalised, it cannot receive too severe a punishment — otherwise, what about the far more serious crimes?

text: 很多人对法律有一种误解。
en: Many people harbour a misunderstanding about the law.

text: 这玩意不是形而上的魔法，而是要人去执行的。
en: This thing is not some metaphysical magic; it has to be carried out by people.

text: 有人会想，卖淫嫖娼入刑，直接判你三年，太可怕了，大家一定不敢卖淫嫖娼了。
en: Some think: criminalise prostitution and soliciting, sentence you to three years straight away — how terrifying, surely no one would dare sell or buy sex then.

text: 这种思想就很有问题，如果这个逻辑成立，那全部违法行为全部判死刑，大家就不敢违法了。
en: This way of thinking is quite flawed. If this logic held, then sentencing all unlawful acts to the death penalty would mean no one would dare break the law.

text: 法律需要执行，执行需要人。
en: The law needs to be enforced, and enforcement needs people.

text: 首先需要人去抓人、审讯、找证据
en: First, people are needed to make arrests, interrogate, and gather evidence.

text: 然后检察官要指控。
en: Then prosecutors must bring charges.

text: 然后法庭审判。
en: Then the court tries the case.

text: 中间还有各种文件各种程序跑来跑去。
en: In between, there are all sorts of documents and procedures shuttling back and forth.

text: 现代刑事诉讼是非常复杂的。
en: Modern criminal procedure is extremely complex.

text: 如果你全部判死刑，唯一的结果就是司法系统直接瘫痪掉。
en: If you sentenced everything to death, the only result would be the judicial system grinding to a halt outright.

text: 或者更严重。
en: Or something worse.

text: 卖淫嫖娼入刑，你要怎么去抓这些鸡和嫖客？
en: If prostitution and soliciting were criminalised, how would you go about arresting these prostitutes and punters?

text: 抓前还得要证据，后面乱七八糟的事一大堆。
en: You would need evidence before the arrest, and there is a whole mess of complications afterwards.

text: 就为了这么点事不值得兴师动众，所以没入刑，就这么简单。
en: It is not worth mobilising such a vast apparatus for something so trivial — that is why it was not criminalised. It really is that simple.

text: 其实即使你被发现了，只要不是当场抓捕，警察一般也不会上门抓你，而是会给你打电话让你伏法。
en: In fact, even if you are found out, as long as you are not caught in the act, the police generally will not come to your door to arrest you; instead they will call you and ask you to surrender to justice.

text: 这时候你只要口头答应，反手卖张机票去边疆或者直接出国躲两个月就行了。
en: At that point you only need to agree verbally, then turn around and buy a plane ticket to the borderlands, or simply leave the country for a couple of months to lie low.

text: 如果这点事公权力都要边控甚至跨境抓捕，那司法机关根本运作不起来。
en: If public power had to impose exit controls, or even carry out cross-border arrests, for something this minor, the judicial authorities simply could not function.

text: 大众根本不知道现代的刑事诉讼是什么状态。
en: The public simply has no idea what the state of modern criminal procedure is like.

text: 中国的基层法官已经忙得眼冒金星了，每天都要开庭是常态，有的一天开两个庭，案件太多已经处理不过来了。
en: China's grassroots judges are already so overwhelmed they see stars; holding court every day is the norm, some preside over two sessions a day, and there are far too many cases to keep up with.

text: 这不是中国一个国家的问题，而是世界范围的问题。
en: This is not a problem for China alone, but a worldwide one.

text: 所以才会有认罪协商这种东西，程序太复杂了，人手不够了，大家谈一谈吧。
en: That is why something like plea bargaining exists — the procedure is too complex and there is not enough manpower, so everyone sits down to talk it through.

text: 那招人吧，多搞点警察，多搞点法官检察官，人手不就够了吗，那么多法学生嗷嗷待哺呢。
en: Then recruit people — employ more police, more judges and prosecutors; would that not solve the manpower shortage? There are so many law students starving for work.

text: 也不行，这个问题比卖淫严重得多得多得多。
en: That will not work either. This problem is far, far, far more serious than prostitution.

text: 因为政府没钱去养这么多人。
en: Because the government has no money to keep so many people on the payroll.

text: 羊毛出在羊身上，多养人，你就得多交税，老爷们的利益动不得，只能苦一苦百姓了。
en: The wool comes from the sheep's back — to employ more people, you must raise taxes; the interests of the elite cannot be touched, so the common people must simply suffer a bit more.

text: 所以卖淫问题根本禁止不了。
en: So the problem of prostitution simply cannot be prohibited.

text: 一方面是人类有性欲需求，这是人类三大欲望。
en: On the one hand, humans have sexual desire — this is one of humanity's three great drives.

text: 另一方面，确实没那么多人去干掉这个产业。
en: On the other hand, there genuinely are not enough people to dismantle this industry.

text: 唯一可能的选项是像当年严打一样从重从快扫荡，你要是觉得这样好，那我没话说，你去政府提建议。
en: The only possible option would be to organise a severe, swift strike-hard crackdown like those of the past. If you think that is good, then I have nothing to say — go and propose it to the government.

text: 现在没有这么做，就说明政府觉得没必要。
en: The fact that this is not being done shows the government does not think it necessary.

text: 即使这么做了，也只能搞掉洗脚店这种有线下门店的，点对点个体户交易根本没办法解决。
en: Even if it were done, it could only take down businesses with physical storefronts like foot-massage parlours; point-to-point, self-employed transactions simply cannot be addressed.

text: 说了这么多，结论就是。
en: After all this, the conclusion is as follows.

text: 目前卖淫嫖娼是没法解决的问题，这个产业一定会存在。
en: At present, prostitution and soliciting are unsolvable problems; this industry is certain to persist.

text: 要是有谁有可行的路径可以说出来让我听听。
en: If anyone has a feasible path, do share it so I can hear it.

text: 合法化听起来很不体面，但是你换个问法就好听很多
en: Legalisation sounds rather undignified, but if you phrase the question differently it sounds much better.

text: 要不要用法律规制卖淫行为。
en: Should we use the law to regulate prostitution?

text: 要么就严厉打击。
en: Or we crack down hard.

text: 这个说过了，没有可行性。
en: I have covered this — it is not feasible.

text: 法律的威严在于执行性，只有能把法律执行下去法律才有威严可言。
en: The authority of the law lies in its enforceability; the law only commands authority if it can actually be enforced.

text: 如果你规定卖淫嫖娼要受处罚，但大部分这么做的人又没受处罚。
en: If you stipulate that those who sell or buy sex must be punished, yet most who do so go unpunished.

text: 那就像说不能加班，但996大行其道一样。
en: That is like saying overtime is forbidden, yet 996 prevails everywhere.

text: 法律的威信会受到极大的冲击。
en: The law's credibility would suffer a tremendous blow.

text: 杀人违法，但你杀人几乎百分百会给你抓住受刑。
en: Murder is against the law, but if you kill someone you will almost certainly be caught and punished.

text: 这才叫法律的威信。
en: That is what the law's credibility truly means.

text: 第二种就是用法律手段控制，超出法律边界的才受刑
en: The second approach is to use legal means to control it, punishing only what falls outside the legal boundaries.

text: 比如执证上岗，合法卖淫的国家也都是这么做的。
en: For example, licensed operation — countries where prostitution is legal do exactly this.

text: 有证的能卖，政府定期检查，没证的全给你撅了。
en: Those with licences may sell, and the government inspects them regularly; those without licences get shut down completely.

text: 但点对点的卖淫依旧无法禁绝，例如大久保公园。
en: But point-to-point prostitution still cannot be eradicated — Ōkubo Park, for instance.

text: 大家都知道那里站着的女人是干什么的，警察也知道。
en: Everyone knows what the women standing there are doing, and the police know too.

text: 还是那句话，政府判断这种事不值得浪费过多公权力去彻底打击，所以他们能存在。
en: As I said before, the government judges such matters not worth expending excessive public power to eradicate completely, which is why they are allowed to exist.

text: 就中国而言，政府想做的事没有不能做的
en: As far as China is concerned, there is nothing the government sets its mind to that it cannot do.

text: 叮咚鸡时期的各种码就说明了这一点。
en: The various codes during the 'ding-dong chicken' period demonstrate precisely this point.

text: 那问题又来了，就算发证，怎么去解决无证经营和点对点交易呢。
en: Then the question arises again: even if licences are issued, how do we deal with unlicensed operation and point-to-point transactions?

text: 这个就很简单了。
en: This is quite simple.

text: 同行是冤家。
en: Those in the same trade are rivals.

text: 有证的那群人会自己想办法帮忙的，能大大降低警方的工作成本。
en: Those with licences will find ways to help on their own, greatly reducing the police's workload.

text: 对于嫖客而言，能去正规店铺为什么要去不正规的，哪些非法卖淫的很难有生存空间。
en: For punters, if they can go to a proper establishment, why would they go to an improper one? Illegal prostitutes would find it hard to survive.

text: 还有人说合法卖淫就会有人抓人去卖。
en: Some also say that with legal prostitution, people would be abducted and forced into selling sex.

text: 这个说法就和狗肉店老板抓狗去卖一样。
en: This argument is just like a dog-meat shop owner catching dogs to sell.

text: 想象在合法卖淫的世界，用贩卖人口的手段抓人卖淫，和有的人想象狗肉店抓宠物狗没区别。
en: Imagining, in a world of legal prostitution, that people would be abducted into prostitution through human trafficking is no different from some people imagining dog-meat shops catching pet dogs.

text: 有执照的才合法，他们用得着去抓人吗？
en: Only those with a licence are legal — why would they need to abduct anyone?

text: 那么多合法鸡，用非法手段做什么。
en: With so many legal prostitutes around, what would they need illegal methods for?

text: 在合法卖淫的国家，执照是很贵的东西，冒着丢执照的风险去抓人那不是傻逼吗？
en: In countries where prostitution is legal, a licence is a costly thing; would anyone be such an idiot as to risk losing it by abducting people?

text: 没执照的他抓不抓人都犯罪，按拐卖人口罪处理就行了。
en: Those without a licence are committing a crime whether they abduct people or not — just treat it as the crime of human trafficking.

text: 把卖淫纳入法律管制后，很多事就好解决了。
en: Once prostitution is brought under legal regulation, many issues become easy to resolve.

text: 比如妓女定期体检，纳入执照考核，不交报告你执照就没了。
en: For example, prostitutes undergo regular health checks, built into the licence assessment; fail to submit the report and you lose your licence.

text: 还有卫生考核和各种规范，尽可能保证安全，不传染疾病。
en: There are also hygiene assessments and various standards, to ensure safety as far as possible and prevent the spread of disease.

text: 各国性病数据都查得到，前几年说日本性病大爆发，但其实是闹麻了，哪怕是这几年有所上涨也比中国低得多。
en: Sexually transmitted disease data for every country is available. A few years back there were claims of a massive STI outbreak in Japan, but it was really overblown; even with the recent rise, the rates are still far lower than China's.

text: 不卫生的个体户鸡才会有性病问题，正规鸡的安全还是有保障的。
en: It is only the unhygienic self-employed prostitutes who have STI problems; the safety of licensed ones is still assured.

text: 第二点是鸡和嫖客的权利问题。
en: The second point is the matter of prostitutes' and punters' rights.

text: 听起来很搞笑，为什么要保护鸡和嫖客的权利。
en: It sounds rather laughable — why should we protect the rights of prostitutes and punters?

text: 事实就是杀人犯有些权利你都得保障，现代社会就这样，怕你做了一些非常反人类的事也不会完全剥夺你的人权，更别说卖淫嫖娼了。
en: The fact is, even murderers are entitled to certain rights that must be safeguarded; modern society is like this — even if you commit something utterly inhumane, your human rights are not entirely stripped away, let alone for prostitution and soliciting.

text: 比如鸡在卖的时候受到暴力，或者嫖客被仙人跳了，不合法那你就自认倒霉吧，合法的情况下你可以报警寻求公权力帮助。
en: For instance, if a prostitute suffers violence while working, or a punter is caught in a honeytrap — if it is illegal, you just swallow your bad luck; if it is legal, you can call the police and seek help from public power.

text: 有的人一说就是你今天合法卖淫，明天就人口贩卖了，后天黑帮上街，大后天毒品枪支满天飞。
en: Some people claim that if prostitution is legalised today, tomorrow it is human trafficking, the day after the gangs take to the streets, and the day after that drugs and guns are everywhere.

text: 这不是滑坡悖论是什么
en: If that is not the slippery-slope fallacy, what is?

text: 日本荷兰这种国家怎么没这样？
en: Why have countries like Japan and the Netherlands not turned out like that?

text: 泰国越南柬埔寨确实比较乱，但有没有可能那是他们国家的问题而不是卖不卖淫的问题，东南亚最小的问题就是卖不卖淫了。
en: Thailand, Vietnam and Cambodia are indeed rather chaotic, but is it not possible that is their own national problem rather than a prostitution problem? The least of Southeast Asia's problems is whether people sell sex.

text: 还有说荷兰卖淫的都是东欧来的穷人，日本神待少女站街，太可怜了。
en: Others say the prostitutes in the Netherlands are all poor people from Eastern Europe, and that Japan's kamimachi girls stand on the streets — how pitiful.

text: 还是那句话，有没有可能是国家本身的问题，而不是卖不卖淫的问题？
en: As I said before, is it not possible it is a problem with the countries themselves, rather than with whether people sell sex?

text: 中国不让卖淫，卖淫卖的少了吗？
en: China forbids prostitution — has the amount of prostitution decreased?

text: 你就算禁止卖淫，还是有一群东欧人会去卖，日本还是会有神待少女。
en: Even if you ban prostitution, there will still be a group of Eastern Europeans who sell sex, and Japan will still have its kamimachi girls.

text: 这跟合不合法没有关系，不是说不合法就不卖了，这个问题我上面解释的很清楚了，就算不卖了，那她们干什么去呢？
en: This has nothing to do with legality — it is not the case that they stop selling just because it is illegal. I explained this point clearly above. And even if they stopped selling, what would they do instead?

text: 最后，我坚决反对卖淫嫖娼。
en: Finally, I am firmly opposed to prostitution and soliciting.

text: 包括短期的和长期的，例如包养，以及彩礼结婚这种变相的卖淫。
en: This includes both short-term and long-term arrangements, such as being kept as a mistress, and the disguised prostitution that is marrying for a bride price.

text: 但是我也认为，在解决不了这些问题的时候，还不如把它们纳入法律管制
en: But I would also favour bringing them under legal regulation when these problems cannot be solved.

text: 大家聊的还挺多的，一开始我还回复一下，后面就懒得回了，再写一点吧。
en: People have discussed quite a lot; at first I replied a bit, but later I could not be bothered, so I will write a little more.

text: 首先我看到的，反对买淫合法的人，攻击支持卖淫合法的人，用的最多的不是实事求是，而是人身攻击。
en: First, what I have observed: those who oppose legalising the buying of sex, when attacking those who support legalising prostitution, rely not on seeking truth from facts but on personal attacks.

text: 你支持买淫合法，你就一定支持贩毒合法，支持黑社会合法，支持人口买卖合法，你老婆女儿也是买淫的，你是男的那就要被抓去当男妓。
en: If you support legalising the buying of sex, then you must also support legalising drug trafficking, legalising organised crime, legalising human trafficking; your wife and daughters are also in the buying-sex trade, and if you are a man you will be seized and made a male prostitute.

text: 这种毫无逻辑撒泼打滚的滑坡行为真令人作呕，完全不是讨论问题的态度。
en: This utterly illogical, tantrum-throwing, slippery-slope behaviour is truly nauseating, and is no attitude for discussing a problem at all.

text: 对于这些人，我只想说一点。
en: To these people, I only want to say one thing.

text: 买淫合法，你老婆女儿就去买淫了，你家男丁就去当面首了。
en: Legalise the buying of sex and your wife and daughters will go into the buying-sex trade, and the men of your household will become kept boys.

text: 如果你认为这样的逻辑是成立的。
en: If you believe this logic holds.

text: 那么现在包养合法，出轨合法，你老婆给别人生孩子合法。
en: Then, given that being kept is legal, cheating is legal, and your wife bearing another man's child is legal.

text: 你老婆现在就已经被出轨了，被人包养了，生的就不是你的孩子。
en: Your wife is already being cheated on, already being kept by another, and the children she bears are not yours.

text: 这是用你们都流氓结论推理出的逻辑
en: This is the logic deduced from your own hooligan conclusions.

text: 如果在一个包养、出轨非法的国家，他们中的你们看我们就是这样的。
en: If, in a country where keeping a mistress and adultery are illegal, the likes of them were to look at us the way you look at them, this is what it would be like.

text: 但实际上，你老婆出没出轨，生的孩子是不是你的，我不知道，你自己去问她吧。
en: But in reality, whether your wife has cheated on you, and whether the children she bore are yours, I do not know — you had better go and ask her yourself.

text: 同理，如果你认为一个人支持卖淫合法，他就是嫖客，就是想嫖娼的人。
en: By the same token, if you believe that a person who supports legalising prostitution is himself a punter, someone who wants to solicit.

text: 那么你是否认为立法者全都是出轨者保养者。
en: Then do you believe all legislators are adulterers and keepers of mistresses?

text: 毕竟是他们让这个东西合法的，他们是支持者。
en: After all, it was they who made this legal; they are the supporters.

text: 这个逻辑显然是站不住脚的。
en: This logic is clearly untenable.

text: 第二点，有人会说，如果买淫合法，这个东西成了一种合法的职业，就会有人逼迫别人去买淫。
en: Second point: some say that if the buying of sex were legal and it became a lawful profession, then people would be forced to buy sex against their will.

text: 我只想说，卖不卖淫和合不合法无关。
en: I only want to say: whether one sells sex has nothing to do with legality.

text: 我上面说的很清楚了，针对买淫嫖娼的惩罚，对于中产，对于良家子是天塌了，但是对于底层人，根本无关紧要。
en: I made this clear above: punishment for buying and soliciting sex is, for the middle class and for people of decent family, the sky falling in, but for those at the bottom it is simply irrelevant.

text: 如果你真的是因为活不下去而去卖淫，那么即使它是非法的，你照样会去做，因为在你的生存危机前，违法和道德的那点成本根本不算什么。
en: If you truly turn to prostitution because you cannot survive, then even if it is illegal you will still do it, because before your survival crisis, the costs of illegality and morality count for nothing.

text: 例子就是大下岗时期，丈夫骑着三轮车送妻子去卖淫。
en: A case in point is the mass-layoff period, when husbands pedalled their wives to prostitution on tricycles.

text: 为了生存去抢劫，去杀人，去盗窃，去卖淫，这种现象在什么时候都有
en: Robbing, killing, stealing, prostituting — all for the sake of survival; this phenomenon exists in every era.

text: 要考虑到是他们为什么会活不下去，而不是他们活不下去后去做什么。
en: We should consider why they could not survive, rather than what they did once they could not.

text: 有一个本质上的问题要考虑清楚。
en: There is an essential question that must be thought through clearly.

text: 那就是当小三，被包养，和卖淫本质上没有任何区别。
en: That is: being a mistress, being kept, and prostitution are essentially no different from one another.

text: 所有反驳我的人，你把卖淫换成前两个自己先思考一下自己说的话有没有道理。
en: To all who rebut me: replace 'prostitution' with the first two and analyse for yourself whether what you say makes any sense.

text: 就比如，卖淫合法了，那么逼良为娼也合法了，所以不能卖淫。
en: For example: if prostitution is legal, then forcing decent women into prostitution is also legal, therefore prostitution cannot be allowed.

text: 那现在当小三合法，逼良为小三是不是也合法？
en: Then, since being a mistress is legal now, is forcing decent women into becoming mistresses also legal?

text: 逼良为小三和逼良为娼的区别是？
en: What is the difference between forcing someone into being a mistress and forcing someone into prostitution?

text: 买给很多人是买，买给一个人就不是买了？
en: Selling to many people is selling; is selling to one person not selling?

text: 为什么当小三合法，被保养合法，而卖淫不合法？
en: Why is being a mistress legal, being kept legal, yet prostitution illegal?

text: 不妨把话说的清楚一点。
en: We might as well state it plainly.

text: 因为垄断性资源能奴役男性，能够让性和婚姻绑定。
en: Because monopolised resources can enslave men, can bind sex and marriage together.

text: 中国人思想里安土重迁的意识是和“家庭”绑在一起的。
en: The attachment to one's homeland and reluctance to relocate, deep in the Chinese psyche, is bound up with the notion of 'family'.

text: 大部分买房就是为了结婚，为了有个家。
en: Most people buy a home precisely in order to marry, to have a family.

text: 如果卖淫合法，男性的结婚意愿会直线下降。
en: If prostitution were legal, men's willingness to marry would plummet.

text: 卖淫合法的世界，买春是什么价格，你参考相关国家，根据物价换算一下就知道了。
en: In a world where prostitution is legal, what is the price of buying sex? You can look at the relevant countries and convert according to the cost of living and you will see.

text: 几百几千就能解决的问题，凭什么要花几十万，还要提供情绪价值去解决？
en: A problem solvable for a few hundred or a few thousand — why on earth should one spend hundreds of thousands, and also provide emotional value to solve it?

text: 房价会断崖式下跌。
en: House prices would fall off a cliff.

text: 而究竟谁从房价里拿走的最多，你买房子的钱究竟大头到了谁的手上，自己去了解吧。
en: And exactly who takes the biggest cut from house prices, exactly whose pockets the bulk of your home-buying money ends up in — go and find out for yourself.

text: 这才是真相，反对者说其他任何乱七八糟的话都是搞笑。
en: That is the real truth; any other nonsense the opponents spout is simply laughable.

text: 最幽默的是，还有说我国合法性是建立在解放妇女，取缔妓院这些东西的基础上的，卖淫不符合马克思主义和社会主义，是把人作为物异化掉了。
en: The most amusing is that some say the legality of prostitution in our country is founded on emancipating women and abolishing brothels, and that prostitution contradicts Marxism and socialism, treating people as objects and alienating them.

text: 装什么外宾呢？
en: Why are you acting like a clueless outsider?

text: 是包养出轨当小三没有违反解放人民的原则还是九九六福报恶意讨薪符合马克思主义？
en: Is it that being kept, cheating, and being a mistress do not violate the principle of liberating the people, or that 996 as a 'blessing' and 'maliciously demanding wages' accord with Marxism?

text: 异化和物化，以及人压迫剥削人的现象还少了吗？
en: Have we not seen more than enough of alienation, objectification, and the oppression and exploitation of people by people?

text: 什么主义都是虚的，如果你还认为社会现象是基于理念构建的，那只能说明你太天真了
en: Any '-ism' is hollow; if you still believe social phenomena are built upon ideals, that only shows how naive you are.
